Commentary.Commentary: Before the run chase Duffy is caught for a chat. He says it was a good feeling to be playing for the Black Caps. When asked about the dropped catch, he says that the ball just landed on the fingertips, which didn't let him to hold on to it. Says he had never expected to take 4 wickets in his debut game and is very happy with his performance.

Right! After a poor start, Pakistan have got to a good score. Their bowlers will think that they have got something to defend. New Zealand will back their batters to get the job done. We will soon find out. Join us for the chase in a bit.

New Zealand were right on the money with the ball. Duffy on debut struck on his 4th ball and then got 2 in 2 in his next over. He got 4 in the end while Kuggeleijn was superb in 4, picking up 3. However, towards the last 5 overs, the Kiwis were taken for a few as they gave away the advantage. They had the chance to bundle the Pakistanis under 100-120 but that didn't happen.

Pakistan opted to bat first and the decision turned into a horror one as they just kept losing wickets. Shafique and Hafeez failed to open their accounts while Haider scored just 3. Shadab Khan then added useful runs along with Shah, Imad and Faheem to take the total over 150. Faheem too played an important hand as he scored 31 off just 18 balls.

End of an interesting innings! Pakistan were off to a terrible start and they were 5 down with the score not even 50 but the skipper's charge towards the middle overs means Pakistan have got to a pretty decent total. Got to give it to the debutant for his performance. Apart from that last over where Duffy went for 20, he was superb otherwise.
Short and wide outside off, Haris looks to carve it over the off side but misses. They sneak a bye. Pakistan end with 153/9.
A quick bumper! Afridi looks to pull but gets an inside edge on the body. They take a run.

Top edge but safe! Short and on middle, Afridi goes for the pull but gets a top edge that goes over the keeper. Sodhi does well to go for the catch but he fails to get there but does well to keep it inside the rope.
Haris Rauf is the last man in.

OUT! TAKEN! A bit of juggle from Guptill but he holds on. A length ball on middle, Faheem goes for the wild swing. He makes a fine connection but it goes as far as deep mid-wicket and goes high in the air. Guptill at the ropes does well to catch. It pops out of his hand but he keeps his eyes on it and takes it in the 2nd attempt.
A bye sneaked! Change of pace from Tickner. He bowls it on a good length too. Afridi looks to push it on the off side but misses. Faheem sneaks a bye.
SIX! In the slot and Shaheen hammers it for a huge six! Full and outside off, it is right under the bat of Afridi. He nails it over long on for a biggie.
Blair Tickner to bowl the final over. 3-0-26-0 from him so far.
Very full and on middle, digged towards mid on for a single. Terrific spell from Kuggeleijn. 3/27 for him.
Short and on middle, pushed back to the bowler where he fails to make a clean stop. Quick single taken in the end.
FOUR! Fine shot! Short and wide outside off from Kuggeleign, Faheem slaps it over cover to hit it wide of the sweeper cover fielder. Good short from Faheem.
Shaheen Afridi joins Faheem Ashraf in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! The short ball is working for the Kiwi's! It's been a constant plan from them to the Pakistani batsmen on this wicket. This one is on middle and Wahab pulls again but it goes straight up in the air towards Santner at long off and he takes it easily. 8 down and 9 balls to go here.
Good length and around off, blocked.
Short ball to Wahab and he's pulled this again! It's gone straight up in the air and Duffy comes under it but can't hold on to it. A couple taken meanwhile.
SIX! BOOM! What way to end the over! Short and down the leg side, Faheem swivels and nails it over fine leg for a biggie. 20 off the over. Another massive over for Pakistan.
SIX! SHOT! What a shot! Full and wide outside off, Faheem nails the drive high over extra cover and it goes way into the stand.
In the air once again! It's short and Wahab get's on the front foot and pulls hard towards deep square leg. It falls short of the fielder running in.
TOP EDGE AND SIX! Duffy bangs it short and bowls it around off, Riaz goes for the pull but gets a top edge. The ball sails over the keeper's head and over the ropes too.
On middle and good length, Faheem makes room to cut for one towards third man.
Who's in next? Wahab Riaz it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is not a great delivery from Duffy considering his earlier spell. It's down the leg side and full but Shadab looks to flick this early and it takes the leading edge and balloons to third man where Ish Sodhi takes a brilliant catch! It was swirling but Sodhi maintained his composure to take it and stifle Pakistan at the death.
Jacob Duffy returns. What a debut it has been for him. 3-0-13-3 from him so far.

SIX! Oh, What A Shot!! 81 metres and it's massive! Once again he's bowled this short towards the body to Faheem and he's creamed this pull straight over the fine leg fielder for a massive six! They're getting a move along now!
Short and outside off stump. Shadab is disappointed with his timing as he cuts for a run.
Short of a good length and into Faheem's pads from over the wicket. Faheem gets hit on the pads as he looks to fend this. They sneak a leg bye.
WIDE! Outside leg stump and short from Tickner once again. Faheem misses the pull. Second wide of the over.
Closer to off stump but still short. Cuts this squarer this time towards deep cover for a single.
Short and outside off by Tickner. Shadab cuts hard towards third man where Sodhi cuts it out. They grab a couple.
Good length and on off stump, Faheem blocks this on the off side and they pinch a run.
WIDE! Short and outside leg from Blair. Ashraf pulls but misses. Wided.
Blair Tickner is back to bowl the 17th.
Quick single and it brings up 100 for Pakistan. Full and wide outside off, Ashraf looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge.
Flatter one on the pads, Faheem looks to defend but misses to get high on the pad.

Floated just outside off, Faheem looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pad. The ball goes to short third man and they take one. Just that run from the over.  Terrific spell from the skipper. Wicketless but just 18 off his 4.

NOT OUT! Pitching outside leg. Fuller ball on the pads. Faheem misses his flick and is hit on the pad. They appeal and not out says the umpire. Santner has a word with his keeper and looks like they so no for the review but as he walks to the bowling mark, he signals the 'T'. Replays roll in and well they won't help as it is pitched outside leg.
DRS time! A very late call from Santner for the LBW review. Let's see what the replays have got to show.

Confusion but safe in the end! Short and around off Faheem hits it hard towards the cover fielder. Shadab thinks for the single but Faheem sends him back. The fielder gives the throw to the bowler but Santner fails to collect the ball.
Shortish and around off, poked to the left of the bowler for nothing.
Shadab misses out this time as he bowls it short and wide outside off, Shadab cuts but fails to find the gap. 16 off the 15th over. A good one for Pakistan.
SIX! The skipper is leading the recovery for Pakistan. Short again and around off, enough time for Shadab to rock back. He does that and hammers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Short and wide again, Shadab cuts it wide of sweeper cover and gets two.
Shortish and around off, punched through mid off for a run.
Short and outside off, punched to deep cover for one.
SIX! Poor ball and Shadab punishes it. Short and just outside off, Shadab quickly gets in the position and tonks it over deep square leg for a huge six. Batting well is the Pakistan skipper.
FOUR! Second ball for Faheem and what a shot! Fuller and outside off, Ashraf drives this on the up and over the mid off fielder. There is no one in the deep. Glorious drive from him.
Oh, he's using the pace and bounce well on this wicket. Bangs this one short and Ashraf looks to pull but misses.
Faheem Ashraf is in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just as Imad was getting a move along. Kuggeleijn bowls another short one outside off stump and it's there to be hit. He jumps and cuts this hard but it's straight down the throat of Tickner at the third man boundary! Turning the screw on this innings here!
Tucks him up this time with a good short one! On middle and rising as it gets to the batsman, Shadab manages to get this for a single on the leg side.
Full and straight from Scott. Wasim drives down the ground but cannot get a run.
FOUR! Races away for four! This is angled away from the left-hander and there is room to cut for Wasim. He cuts and cuts hard behind point and Tickner cannot stop the boundary! Fantastic shot.
Change in bowling. Scott Kuggeleijn is back on. 2-0-9-1 from him so far.
Flat and around off, defended towards the cover region.
On the pads this time and full, Imad flicks for a single.
FOUR! Fantastic cover drive from Imad. Santner pushes this ball fuller and Imad drives this gloriously towards the vacant cover region for a much needed boundary!
Quick single! Shadab dabs this to short third man and they scamper for a run. Seifert collects and takes the bails off but no chance of a run out.
Good fielding from the bowler. Shadab drives this down the ground from a delivery on middle and Santner gets down well to stop the run.
Flatter and outside off. Imad cuts this late towards short third man for one.
FOUR! Good end to the over! Short and on the pads, Shadab helps it over short fine leg and finds the fence.
Seeing his skipper go big, Imad tries to copy him and looks to slog it over long on but doesn't connect it as well as he would've liked. It goes towards long on. A single.
On middle, paddled towards short fine leg for one.
SIX! BOOM! First one of the evening. Tossed up and outside off, Shadab hammers it over the bowler's head and clears the fence.
Flat and around middle, worked on the leg side for one.

Put down! Conway misjudges the chance! Floated outside off, Imad goes inside out and lifts it over extra cover. Conway from deep cover runs to his left and ahead. Gets to the ball but he fails to get hands to it. Poor from him. They take two.
Ish Sodhi from the other end.
Full and on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Pushes this fuller one wide of the point fielder and this time Imad says I will run. They change ends.
Another slower one around off, Shadab pushes it towards point and thinks for a single but Imad is not interested.
Flat and around off, poked towards point for nothing.
Flat and around off, worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Mitchell Santner is back. 1 - 0 - 7 - 0 for him so far.
Short and wide outside off, Shadab goes after it and looks to carve it on the off side but misses. 48/5 at the end of 10 overs.

NOT OUT! That was a stunning work near the ropes by Duffy though. The man is doing his magic on the debut. Almsot a screamer. Short and wide outside off, Shadab carves it over backward point. Duffy at third man runs to his right and takes a superb catch.
Has Duffy taken a blinder at the ropes? That looks really close. The third umpire feels his left hand is touching the ropes.
No run.
Back of a length and around off, pushed towards point for one.
Shortish and on middle, worked towards the leg side for one.
Length ball around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and wide, pushed through mid on for one. 3 runs and a wicket from the over.
Around off and a bit short too. Shadab looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pad.
Imad calmly tucks the flatter ball around middle towards mid-wicket to open his account.
Short and on middle, pulled to long on for one.
The wickets keep tumbling for Pakistan here. Imad Wasim is out to bat at no.7 earlier than expected.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shah falls now and it is Sodhi who gets the wicket. Half the side done and dusted for Pakistan with the score not even reaching 50. Tossed up and on middle, Shah gets down and looks to slog sweep. He ends up getting a top edge that balloons up high in the air but it goes as far as point. Guptill there is as safe as house as he makes no mistake.
Short and wide, Shah cuts it hard but finds the cover fielder.
Full and straight from Tickner to end the over. Shah drives straight and picks up one to keep strike.
Back of a length and around off, poked towards the off side for one.
Full and wide, pushed towards cover for one.
FOUR! Clipped off the pads! Tickner misses the line and bowls it on the pads, Shah flicks it past the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
Good length ball on middle and off played it on off side.
Lovely start from Tickner. A well-directed bumper on middle and off. Shah looks to pull but at the last moment opts against it.
Blair Tickner will bowl the 8th over.
Single on the last ball and just 3 from Sodhi's opening over. This is flat and just around off, Shah goes deep in his crease and cuts it really late towards deep point for one.
Shortish and wide but it keeps low. It was the wrong' un from him. Shah looks to cut but makes no connection.
Flatter and just outside off, punched to cover for nothing.
Floated around off, blocked off the front foot.
Shadab is off the mark! A fuller ball outside off, he looks to drive but gets a thick inside edge which goes towards short fine leg. A quick single.
Short and around middle to begin, pulled down to deep mid-wicket for one
Here's Ish Sodhi!
Good line once again. On middle stump and on a length, Khan blocks this. Pakistan are struggling here, 29/4 after the powerplay.
Good bowling this from Duffy. Khan defends a straight ball on middle.
Straighter one towards middle stump and Shadab drives straight towards the bowler.
WIDE! Duffy pushes this delivery down the leg side. Looks to flick this but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Good running! Fuller outside off stump from Duffy. Shah drives this to mid off and takes one.
Outside off stump and angling away from the left-hander, pushed to cover.
No hat-trick for Duffy! He went full, fast and straight but Shah was ready for it. He flicked it through square leg and got a brace.
Will Duffy bowl his third? Yes! Here he is. Can he get a hat-trick on debut? Khushdil to face.
Good run! Good from Shah. A length ball around middle, he tucks it towards mid-wicket and calls for a single.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Short and wide outside off, Shah cuts it over point and finds the fence. This should calm the nerves in the Pakistani camp.
Length ball and just outside off, punched towards the man at mid off.
Kuggeleijn goes full and wide, Shah looks to drive but the ball takes the inner half and goes back to the bowler.
Shortish and just outside off, pushed towards point.
The new batsman to the crease is Khushdil Shah.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kuggeleijn joins the party now! Pakistan, what is happening here? A team hat-trick here. Pakistanis are unable to read the bounce on the surface here. A back of a length ball around middle, Haider looks to work it on the leg side but the ball hits him high on the bat and loops up in the air to his left. Kuggeleijn goes after it and takes it easily. Pakistan in an absolute mess here.
All sorts of trouble for Pakistan! Shadab Khan will look to steady the ship at no.5.

OUT! TAKEN! Two in two and Duffy in on a hat-trick. The Professor has been sent packing for a golden duck. A shortish ball just outside off, Hafeez spots width and looks to slam it over mid on but mistimes it. A dolly for Chapman there. Pakistan in a big, big trouble as their most experienced man departs without opening his account.
The veteran, Mohammad Hafeez, walks out to bat at no.4.

OUT! CAUGHT THIS TIME! Rizwan makes room and jumps out of the crease. Duffy bowls it wide and full. Rizwan looks for the drive over cover but ends up hitting it off the toe end. The ball goes straight to Phillips at cover. He takes it easily. Second wicket for Duffy.

Put down! A tough chance but Duffy got a hand to it. A length ball around off, Rizwan pushes it hard back to the bowler. It is to the right of Duffy who dives to that side. Gets hands to it but fails to hang on.
Around off and on a length, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Flicked away and flicked away well! A length ball around off, it is angled in. Rizwan uses the angle and nails the flick. It goes to the fine leg fence on one bounce.
Nicely bowled! Length ball outside off, shapes a touch further away as Rizwan has a poke at it away from his body.
Another length ball around off, Ali connects his swing but not from the middle. Manages to clear the men in the ring. Mid on gets to it and they get 2.
Beaten! Kuggeleijn has his tail up. Another shortish ball in the channel. Ali pokes but is beaten. Just 2 from the over so far. Can he end well?
Swing and a miss! A good length ball outside off, Haider swings hard down the leg side but only connects with thin air.
Quick single! Full and wide outside off, driven towards mid off for a quick single.
Good length and around off, Rizwan looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pad.

Just over! Lucky for Ali there. A shortish ball around off, Haider looks to work it on the leg side but ends up getting leading edge. The ball goes towards cover. Phillips tries to go back and catch but fails to get hands to it.
Scott Kuggeleijn will bowl the third over. Just the one over for spin.

EDGED AND FOUR! That was full and wide from Duffy, Rizwan threw his bat at it. He gets a thick outside edge that flies over the slip cordon and into the third man fence. 5 runs and a wicket from the over.
Good length and around off, blocked off the front foot.
Haider Ali is in at no. 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! And Duffy strikes in his first over of his debut! A length ball around off and middle, Shafique looks to flick but gets a leading edge. The ball loops up towards mid on and it is a simple catch for Chapman. What an amazing start to his career!
That's a ripper! Shortish and around off, shapes away as the batter pokes at it get beaten.
Short and wide out, poked towards point for one.

Just wide! That would've been an amazing catch and a superb start to the career for Duffy! He runs in and bowls it full and outside off, RIzwan looks to drive but hits it uppishly to the left side of the bowler. Duffy dives to his left but fails to get a hand to it.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's Jacob Duffy on debut.
Single to end the opening over. A short ball from Santner, Rizwan pulls it down to deep square leg for a run. He will keep the strike.
This one is slightly slower through the air and it pitches around off and then turns away as Rizwan gets his bat down in defense.
Flatter and around off, pushed towards the cover fielder.
A couple now! Shortish and around off, Rizwan pulls it wide of the deep square leg fielder for a brace.

EDGY FOUR! Another arm from Santner. He is not offering any room. This time Rizwan gets an inside edge which races down to the fine leg fence. The man from the ring gave it a chase but he failed to cut it off.
Good start from Santner. An arm ball to begin, it is pitched around middle and it kept coming in. Rizwan looks to defend but is hit on the body.

Right! We are done with all the pre-game formalities. It is time for the action out in the middle. The two umpires stride out to the center and the Kiwi players follow them. Mohammad Rizwan and Abdullah Shafique will start the innings for Pakistan. Mitchell Santner will open the bowling for New Zealand. Here we go...
Before the action begins, players from both the sides walk out in the middle for their respective National Anthems.

Pitch report - Craig McMillan and Jeetan Patel are in for the pitch report. Patel says that it is the same wicket that was used during the West Indies series. McMillan feels that it might be on the slower side. Patel adds that looking at the dimensions, you would think it might be tough for the spinners but it offers some bounce which can assist them.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Tim Seifert (WK), Devon Conway, Glenn Phillips, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner (C), Mark Chapman, Scott Kuggeleijn, Ish Sodhi, Jacob Duffy (T20I DEBUT), Blair Tickner.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Abdullah Shafique, Haider Ali, Mohammad Hafeez, Shadab Khan (C), Khushdil Shah, Imad Wasim, Faheem Ashraf, Wahab Riaz, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf.

Mitchell Santner, the Kiwi skipper, tells that it looks like a good wicket and he is happy to bowl first. On the captaincy, Santner says he is really proud to lead the team again. Mentions that Jacob Duffy is making his debut for New Zealand. Says Pakistan is a quality side and they have good pacers and spinners in their ranks as well but adds they are prepared for it.

Shadab Khan, the Pakistan skipper, says that they want to put runs on board. Adds that it is a proud moment for him and his family. Tells that they will miss Babar Azam but adds it is an opportunity for the youngsters. Feels they have prepared well for the series.
TOSS - Both the skippers are out in the middle for the toss. Up goes the coin and it lands in Pakistan's favor. THEY WILL BAT FIRST!

After the Covid-19 scares in the Pakistani camp since their arrival in New Zealand, we are almost ready to roll. Yes! It's time for New Zealand vs Pakistan. And it begins with the T20Is. First things first, Babar Azam and Kane Williamson, both will be missing out this game. Both the teams get slightly weaker in absence of their star skippers and players but that doesn't mean there's any dearth of talent in either team. Expect a high-scoring encounter when both the team take the field. Stay with us for the toss and team news.
